Nina: Morning riff: who brought the tiny jar of honey? Its ambrosia level. :honey_pot:
Ollie: Not me. I brought the granola but Im not worthy of ambrosia. :laughing:
Zara: Quick poll: react 1 for "keep it in pantry", 2 for "put in kitchen for communal use", 3 for "claim it as altar to good mornings".
Tao: Also, one-liner contest: best 5-word breakfast caption wins the jar (temporary custody). Go.
kudos-bot: Shoutout to Lina for fixing the coffee machine yesterday! :tada:
Nina: 2 from me. Sharing is caring and sticky-finger-approved.
Ollie: One-liner: "Honey: breakfasts tiny sweet miracle."
Zara: One-liner: "Spread joy, not spreadsheets." Mic drop.
Tao: One-liner: "Spoonful of sun, please." Simple, sincere.
snack-bot: Reminder: label jars with initials if you want return policy enforced. Community pantry rules posted on the fridge.
Nina: Tally: 2 wins. Honey goes to the communal shelf. Whoever enjoys it, leave a tiny thank-you note in #kudos.
Ollie: Also, who left a hilarious meme in #random last night? Laughed out loud. Credit where due.
kudos-bot: Meme credit goes to @Wren. Extra kudos sent! :sparkles:
